title: 第21章 中下之资修仙三个月就能败一流武者第22章 徒弟突破返还练气大圆满修为
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 萧家大堂前。
劲猛的一拳袭来。
三长老大惊失色，连忙双手拦在身前。
砰！
闷的一声响起，三长老猛然退后了五步。
还未待他稳住身形，又是一道劲风袭来。
他猛然抬头看去，簫火火不知何时，已经靠近！
赤红的一拳，毫无章法的袭来。
可这一幕，却令三长老头皮发麻，接连运起身上的劲，慌忙之下拉起身法，便是吃力的闪躲著。
站在汉白玉台阶上的萧斩三人难以置信，目瞪口呆的道：
“这真的是火火吗？”
“这居然是真的！”
只见眼前的少年灵活追击，无论是速度，还是出招的劲猛，都要胜了三长老一个度。
后者只能惊慌的躲闪著，就是还手，也被轻易的化解。
三长老居然被全程压著打！
如此不可思议的一幕，简直叫人难以相信！
隨著簫火火的出招，眾人也已经是看出了他自信的底蕴。
那便是强悍的实力！
簫火火无论是身法，和招式，看起来都没什么章法，並不是什么厉害的武技绝学，单纯就是靠著一身实力，力大砖飞，把三长老逼的毫无还手之力！
在几人的惊嘆间，簫火火猛然跃起了身体，朝下猛然击出一拳。
下方的山长老见状，只得立即提气抵御。
啪！
拳掌相接！
却见那三长老的双脚死死抵住地面，居然在泥地上，拖出了长达八九米的拖痕，才稳稳停了下来，足见那一拳之威猛。
这一拳之下，簫火火也转身回落，收下了气息，点到为止。
见状，三长老的身体才疲惫的鬆了下来，有些颓意，一身的气血都在震盪著。
他看向簫火火，仿佛不认识眼前的少年一般，吃惊的喘著气道：
“少族长，真是好生厉害！”
或许旁人看来，就是他被簫火火单方面压制著。
不过，只有在场上交手的他，才最为清楚。
簫火火每一招每一式看似没有章法，只是单纯的大力和迅猛，但在拳掌相交之间，却每每有著一道恐怖的力量，在震盪著他的体骨，使得他越大越吃力。
簫火火平復好体內的气息后，呼气道：
“爹，三位长老，这便是我纳了九道灵气的实力。”
三人宛若木雕般呆滯片刻，隨后双眼都大放光彩，哈哈大笑起来！
“哈哈哈，好好好，实在是好啊！”
萧斩大笑著一连道了几声好，意气风发，感觉一瞬间年轻了不少。
他直步来到簫火火的身前，反覆的打量，眸子中的喜色和震颤依旧不断：
“好，不愧是我萧斩的儿子，居然也是有著超越大宗师之姿！”
一旁看著的几名长老脸色一黑，这个萧斩怎么越发的不要脸了？
那和你有什么关係，明明是仙师的本事好吧？
不过，三位长老却也不会拂了萧斩的面子，而是一齐上前恭喜道：
“族长说的没错，老夫早就看出来火火岂非池中物。”
“此前落寞，不过是没遇到好的老师罢了。”
大长老也解气的哼了一声：
“那飘渺宗少宗主就是没眼光，以现在的架势，贏得肯定是我萧家少族长！”
content_en:
In front of the Xiao family lobby.
A powerful punch came.
The third elder was shocked and quickly held his hands in front of him.
Bang!
There was a muffled sound, and the third elder suddenly took five steps back.
Before he could stabilize his body, another strong wind hit him.
He suddenly looked up, and Xiao Huohuo was approaching without knowing it!
The red punch came without any plan.
But this scene made the third elder's scalp numb. He summoned up all his strength and hurriedly pulled up his body, but struggled to dodge.
Standing on the white marble steps, Xiao Zhan and the others were in disbelief and said in stunned silence:
"Is this really Huohuo?"
"This is actually true!"
The young man in front of me was able to nimbly pursue him. Whether it was speed or the force of his moves, he was even better than the third elder.
The latter could only dodge in panic, and even if he fought back, he was easily resolved.
The third elder was actually suppressed and beaten the whole time!
Such an incredible scene is simply unbelievable!
With Xiao Huohuo's moves, everyone has already seen the depth of his confidence.
That is powerful strength!
Xiao Huohuo seems to have no rules in terms of body skills and moves. He is not a powerful martial arts master. He just relies on his strength to fly with bricks and force the third elder to be unable to fight back!
While several people were marveling, Xiao Huohuo suddenly jumped up and punched downwards.
When the mountain elder below saw this, he had to immediately raise his energy to resist.
Snap!
Fist to palm!
However, he saw that the third elder's feet were firmly pressed against the ground, and they actually dragged eight or nine meters of drag marks on the muddy ground before they stopped steadily, which showed the power of that punch.
Under this punch, Xiao Huohuo also turned around and fell back, holding back his breath until it stopped.
Seeing this, the third elder's body relaxed from exhaustion, feeling a little depressed, and all the energy and blood in his body was shaking.
He looked at Xiao Huohuo, as if he didn't recognize the young man in front of him, and gasped in surprise:
"Young patriarch, you are so awesome!"
Perhaps in the eyes of others, he was being unilaterally suppressed by Xiao Huohuo.
However, it is only when he fights on the court that he knows it best.
Xiao Huohuo's every move and style seems to have no structure, just pure strength and swiftness, but between the intersection of fists and palms, there is always a terrifying force, shaking his body bones, making it more difficult for him as he gets bigger.
After Xiao Huohuo calmed down the breath in his body, he exhaled:
"Dad, three elders, this is my strength after absorbing nine spiritual energies."
The three of them were as dull as wood carvings for a moment, and then their eyes lit up and they burst into laughter!
"Hahaha, good, good, really good!"
Xiao Zhan laughed and said hello several times in a row, feeling high-spirited and feeling much younger for an instant.
He walked straight to Xiao Huohuo and looked at her repeatedly. The joy and trembling in his eyes remained constant:
"Well, he is indeed my son, Xiao Zhan, and he actually has the appearance of surpassing the great master!"
The expressions on the faces of the elders who were watching turned dark. Why is this Xiao Zhan becoming more and more shameless?
What does that have to do with you? It’s obviously the ability of an immortal master, right?
However, the three elders would not offend Xiao Zhan. Instead, they stepped forward together to congratulate:
"The patriarch is right. I have long seen that the fire is not a thing in the pond."
"I was lonely before because I didn't have a good teacher."
The great elder also snorted in relief:
"The young master of the Piao Miao Sect just has no vision. With his current attitude, I will definitely win, the young patriarch of the Xiao family!"
title_en: Chapter 21: A person with average talent can defeat a first-rate warrior in three months of cultivation. Chapter 22: Disciple breaks through and returns to the Great Perfection of Qi training.
